canonical_spec.title: Banking, risk and international finance
canonical_spec.assessment: Analyze financial balance sheets, funding and systemic risk, and design defensible stress and governance decisions.
canonical_spec.project: Build an original bank or fund stress case covering liquidity, solvency, collateral, currency mismatch, governance and crisis choices.

shared_rules.exam_contract: Original structurally distinct Forms A/B, five20-point domains totaling100 per form. Suggested240-minute closed-resource exam with nonprogrammable calculator; this is an uncalibrated design target. Supply all contractual data/probabilities and any specialist numerical tables. All12 chapter outcomes must receive explicit assessed evidence. Complete determinate solutions, proof assumptions, exact subpart point allocations and open-answer rubrics. Coordinate blueprints before full prose. Reassessment must change mechanism/information/timing and task, not merely numbers.

domains.D1: Intermediation, screening/monitoring, balance-sheet capital and credit decisions (c01–c03)
domains.D2: Finite market-loss measures and actual dated funding/ALM (c04–c05)
domains.D3: Operational/legal/model controls and coherent joint/reverse stress (c06–c07)
domains.D5: Regulatory incentives, systemic mechanisms and accountable risk decisions (c10–c12)

shared_rules.acceptance: All payloads independently recomputed, all prompts solved, methods already taught, explicit provenance/source scope, peer/coordinator audit before acceptance. Root alone assembles final v11.html and updates canonical/shared/hosting. No subagents, new installations or external messages.
shared_rules.files_and_checks: HTML fragments only, no extra h1; Form A uses form-a/solutions-a and Form B form-b/solutions-b IDs, project uses project. Unique v11-a/v11-b/project-prefixed detail IDs; flat reader links. Quiet standard-library check() -> JSON-safe result, no assert-based input validation, full bounded normal/-O portable project CLI/API. Each author record binds all nonself owned payloads and records complete prompt/proof/numerical/source audit. Root owns shared canonical/build/verification/hosting. Report freeze before peer.
shared_rules.source_scope: Reuse accepted method-specific sources with exact inspected scope. New current/legal/empirical assertions require actual primary body retrieval and date/jurisdiction; prefer complete original synthetic contracts. No imagined market data or actual authority.

Choose tractable new values, teach no new hidden method, avoid repeating chapter labs. Provide all12 chapter map and full solutions/rubrics. Send five-domain blueprint before drafting.

assignments.scope: Build an original integrated institution stress/decision project, beyond reusing c12 or concatenating chapter labs. One coherent fictional bank or fund with dated balance sheets, actual credit loss/repayment, nonlinear or joint market risk, separately eligible collateral and funding, named currencies/accounts/convertibility/settlement cutoffs, operational/model/legal evidence, and a feasible financed crisis response. Trace transfers/creditors/equity exactly and stop or explicitly retain missed claims; no undocumented cash or guarantees. Require learner sensitivity/reverse-stress work, a counterparty or network transmission and accountable governance/incentive memo; the project plus oral transfer should connect all12chapters. Use a bounded finite standard-library model, full original provenance/input/output/manifest/README, independent original-contract checker and meaningful financial interventions. Complete instructor benchmark,100-point rubric with five essential domains, required learner report/code/evidence/limitations and unfamiliar transfer tasks. Distinguish pricing/physical probabilities/scenarios and actual legal authority. Keep scope finite and calculation economically purposeful. Send architecture with dated resource/claim maps and numerical anchors to root before full prose.

blueprint_differentiation.form_a: Prefer screening and funded lending; tail atom and collateral deadline; obligation identity and coherent stress; insurance participation with export-currency access; regulatory perimeter with financed systemic/governance response.
blueprint_differentiation.form_b: Prefer monitoring/restructuring; loss dependence and ALM value-versus-income; common failure/model-use and reverse boundary; pension/guarantor with sovereign financing; conduct/resolution with distinct network and governance decision.
blueprint_differentiation.limits: These are coordinated architecture choices, not extra tasks per question. Keep five tractable20-point cases, all12chapters evidenced, all required data provided and full answers. Authors may improve the construction while preserving structural distinction.

peer_rotation_reason: A three-way cycle keeps all separate reviews independent and avoids two consecutive large reviews on one specialist: A to c05_review, B to ito_author, project to bs_author. No new agents.
